newsitem.title: UK: Carpetright shares climb on sales, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Carpetright shares climb on sales, outlook.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Carpetright Plc jumped on Tuesday, boosted by a confident outlook and encouraging sales growth since the start of May, dealers said.

The company announced annual pre-tax profits of 32.2 million stg, in line with expectations which ranged from 30.5 to 34 million. It said comparable store sales rose four percent in the seven weeks since the start of May.
"The results were as expected but they had a good outlook and their sales have done well in the last couple of months," one market-maker said.
The shares were 44-1/2p higher to 485-1/2 by 0753 GMT.
The company said it expected to at least maintain an improvement in gross margins during the coming year and was confident of making further progress.
